item.title: GTT Receives Tank Design Order for Two LNG Carriers
item.description: GTT announced that it has received an order from the shipyard Samsung Heavy Industries for the tank design of two new Liquefied Natural Gas Carriers (LNGCs) in the first quarter of 2026.GTT will design the cryogenic tanks of the vessels, each with a capacity of 174,000 m³.

item.title: UK Marine Industry Salaries Not Keeping Up
item.description: Marine Resources has released the third edition of its UK Marine Industry Salary & Employment Survey, highlighting how employees are increasingly focused on salary.Managing Director and Founder, James Ward, says the survey highlights a clear shift in employee priorities since 2022.
